ox_alpha_analysis.method: 3 batches of 3 patents each (single-call analysis of 9 patents exceeded bash tool timeout, so split into batches). Each batch ~20KB prompt, ~6000 tokens response, ~36-39s elapsed.
ox_alpha_analysis.blocking_test_definition: A prior art patent BLOCKS the candidate if and only if its claims read on ALL THREE elements: (a) intra-procedural retrieved-clot physical signature measurement, (b) computing a risk score from said signature + procedural features for sICH/mRS, (c) gating a continuation/escalation decision on said score. Under KSR, a patent may also be blocking-via-combination if it would be obvious to combine its teaching with another cited patent's teaching to produce all three elements.
